calls.text: {"meetingId": "T110", "tickets": [{"templateId": "16995f94-ef6c-5a22-ab66-51b66b8e9006", "title": "Start retirement plan rollover", "text": "Start preparing the Silver Marmot Laboratories 401(k) rollover for Nadia Copperwisp after her separation at the end of September 2024, including receiving the account registration and the company-stock portion (38% of the $914,000 balance).", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-09-06", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "They agreed by 2024-09-06 to start preparing the Silver Marmot Laboratories 401(k) move after separation, including receiving account registration and company-stock portion."}, {"templateId": null, "title": "Obtain formal pension election packet from Silver Marmot Laboratories", "text": "Obtain the formal pension election packet from Silver Marmot Laboratories for Nadia Copperwisp, since only portal estimates were available for the single-life pension, joint-and-survivor pension for Galen, and delayed Social Security options.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-08-23", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "By 2024-08-23, the formal pension election packet is needed because only portal estimates were available."}, {"templateId": null, "title": "Review first-year retirement income and withholding", "text": "Review first-year retirement income and withholding for Nadia Copperwisp, incorporating the final paycheck, unused vacation payout, and first pension timing into the tax projection.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-09-13", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "They agreed by 2024-09-13 to review first-year retirement income and withholding because Tobin noted final paycheck, unused vacation payout, and first pension timing were not yet in the tax projection."}]}
